profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer, DevEx at Rula
profile.summary: DevOps junkie. I create tools, systems, and processes on a daily basis to support the entire development lifecycle from commit to deploy.

positions.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
positions.description: Improved engineering efficiency and reduced costs across teams through automation, infrastructure upgrades, and better processes. Started the org's first cross-team technical review process, which cut down on late-stage project churn and helped teams work together more effectively. Used AI tooling to handle a large data obfuscation config migration, saving the org a meaningful amount annually. Built out CI/CD so teams could spin up their own ephemeral branch environments with remote debugging. Made it easier for ML teams to stand up infrastructure by creating a shared, reusable module, and cut compute costs by moving to AWS Graviton instances. Executed AWS Savings Plans to get more out of our cloud spend.
positions.insights: Skills: Terraform · ArgoCD · Cross-team Collaboration · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Amazon Web Services (AWS)

positions.title: Senior Staff DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Led the modernization of SDLC at SonderMind through infrastructural updates, augmentation, and CI/CD automation while considering and adjusting existing process requirements. This has led to a rapidly scaling velocity of delivery while simultaneously increasing our quality controls and security.

This was accomplished through several efforts focused on building the foundational components to a code-driven SDLC: GitOps-driven testing, Infrastructure as Code, Kubernetes-powered deployments, and SDLC supporting all of the components used to build those capabilities out. By controlling all of these components via their own SDLC we have ensured that the very foundation of our code delivery chain is self-correcting and resilient to personnel changes and human error.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Amazon EKS · Infrastructure as code (IaC) · Helm (Software) · Secure SDLC

positions.title: DevOps Admin
positions.description:
Led the transition to modern CI/CD development lifecycle and infrastructure. Migrated production code from Github to GitLab CI to implement quality control and gating mechanisms in order to accelerate delivery to prod. Empowering developers through increasingly-robust test infrastructure while laying the groundwork for sub-hour dev to prod feature delivery. Innovated and implemented several integration testing tools with no solutions in the wild (i.e. sub-10 second containerized test DB refresh tooling for rapid, reliable Cypress testing).

Created Processes and Procedures and stood up 3rd-party Security through IaC in support of SOC Type  2 certification. Performed internal audits of infrastructure, procedures, and access.
positions.insights: Skills: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · GitLab CI · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Terraform · Secure SDLC

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Actively maintained, upgraded, and created DevOps solutions for a large, multi-year data visualization tool rewrite. Worked extensively with Gitlab CI, OpenStack, and Docker on a daily basis. Introduced a versioning flow to the project that aligned with the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) development cycle. Created processes for release flow and comprehensive, staged testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Docker · Data Management · Process Engineering · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Gitlab

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Split time between Java Development against a telemetry data visualization system and DevOps for my team. Introduced the team to containerization (Docker), updated and re-architected  the team's automated CI stack in Jenkins before beginning the transition to Gitlab CI, actively maintained multiple Linux resources, created a web application for dynamically deploying and exposing our data visualization software, and added functionality to the team's core application, "TRACE".

positions.title: IT RSS - Technical Undergrad
positions.description:
Worked extensively with microcontrollers in the creation of several systems including:
     - A homemade "Segway"
     - Numerous custom-lighting systems
     - A cellular-connected, person-counter for tracking direction and number of people using public transit

Gained an extensive understanding of control systems, specifically PID (Proportional Integral Derivative) control methods and implementation.

Designed and implemented several PCBs for the numerous Segway sensors and peripherals.

company.name: Missouri University of Science and Technology

positions.title: iSAFE Technical Intern
positions.description: Wrote communication protocol for autonomous robots, implemented experimental encryption technology, and stood up an internal website.

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
Performed research into hyper-heuristic genetic algorithms and hardware optimization.
- Delved into the field of Evolutionary Computing
- Learned research methodologies and technical writing
- Worked extensively with Python
